public.import_run_ready.definition: select "import_run"."id", "import_run"."user_id", "import_run"."status", "import_run"."updated_at" from "import_run" inner join "upload" on "upload"."id" = "import_run"."upload_id" where ("import_run"."status" in ('extracted', 'structuring') and "upload"."kind" in ('cv_pdf', 'cv_docx'))
public.import_run_ready.name: import_run_ready
